thread.title: Maxim Group Trims Apple (AAPL) Target Price to $160.00

author: ABMN Staff
title: Maxim Group Trims Apple (AAPL) Target Price to $160.00
text:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) had its target price cut by investment analysts at Maxim Group from $212.00 to $160.00 issued to clients and investors on Thursday, The Fly reports. The firm currently has a “hold” rating on the iPhone maker’s stock. Maxim Group’s price objective would suggest 1.32% from the stock’s current price. The analysts noted that the move was a valuation call.
Several other equities analysts have also commented on the stock. Citigroup dropped their Apple from $265.00 to $240.00 and set a “buy” rating on the stock in a research note on Friday, November 2nd. Rosenblatt Securities set a $165.00 Apple and gave the company a “neutral” rating in a research note on Thursday, December 6th. Morgan Stanley increased their Apple from $226.00 to $253.00 and gave the company an “overweight” rating in a research note on Thursday, November 8th. Royal Bank of Canada set a $240.00 Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research note on Monday, September 24th. Finally, JPMorgan Chase & Co. began coverage on Apple in a report on Thursday, September 27th. They issued an “overweight” rating and a $272.00 price objective for the company. Three twenty-six have issued a hold rating and twenty-one have issued a buy rating to the stock. Apple has a consensus rating of “Hold” and a consensus target price of $205.93.
